method: Read-only comparison of originals; exact SHA-256, existing pHash Hamming distance, cached CLIP cosine similarity, reference-caption word-set Jaccard as context, COCO category overlap, original dimensions, and native-resolution visual inspection. CLIP/Jaccard are descriptive signals, not duplicate classifiers. Raw same-coordinate pixel differences and correlations were also computed because every reviewed pair has matching original dimensions. These values are descriptive, not a duplicate classifier.
